jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Planning Lead
jobs.description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 130 countries and more than 80 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 7 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks. Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 12 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco, Sao Paulo and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com

Position Overview

We are looking for a Revenue Strategy & Planning Lead who sits at the intersection of rigorous analysis and relentless execution. In this role, you will partner directly with our senior leaders (CRO, CFO, COO) to help shape our global growth plans—and then roll up your sleeves to drive those cross-functional projects across the finish line. We don't just want a thinker who builds plans in a silo; we need a doer who can manage complex strategic initiatives from the whiteboarding phase to full deployment.

This is an opportunity to help build the growth engine behind one of the world's most ambitious cross-border payments platforms. If you view ambiguity as an invitation to build, excel at project management, and know how to turn complex data into an actionable roadmap, this is the role for you.

What you’ll own

- Strategic projects: Driving critical cross-functional revenue initiatives to completion. You will act as the execution engine for all our major GTM projects

- Competitive intelligence: Owning deep research into competitive landscapes and customer segments to inform our strategic direction and sales motions.

- The growth plan: Coordinating our major planning cycles, while arming our sales leaders with the rigorous insights they need to set strategy and targets.

- Sales operational excellence: Fixing what's broken and optimizing what works. You own the tactical projects that strip inefficiency out of the sales process and give our reps more time to sell.

Who you are

- You know that “let’s just launch it” actually involves 47 distinct steps. You take massive, ambiguous goals, map the entire journey, and get a room full of strong opinions executing on a single plan.

- You know a spreadsheet isn't a strategy. You take dense, complex data points and translate them into the real-world operational changes our sales leaders actually care about.

- You are allergic to the phrase "that's not my job." When a critical growth initiative stalls between functions, you are the one who jumps in and pushes it across the finish line.

- You care about AI as a tool, not a buzzword. You are constantly scouting for practical ways to plug AI into our daily workflows to eliminate manual grunt work and make the revenue org ruthlessly efficient.

What you bring

- 5-8+ years of high-growth B2B experience: You’ve cut your teeth in Sales Strategy & Ops, Consulting, BizOps, Strategic Finance, or Chief of Staff roles.

- Scars from actual execution: You don't just build strategy decks; you have a proven track record of successfully rolling them out across complex global SaaS, fintech, or platform businesses.

- Boardroom confidence: You are completely comfortable holding your own with C-level executives to drive strategy, annual planning, and board-level deliverables.

- Bonus points for: Experience in emerging markets or cross-border payments, experience navigating international teams, and the ability to get your hands dirty with SQL,  Tableau and AI-powered tools..

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
About Thunes

Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for   key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

- Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.

- Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.

- Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.

- Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.

- Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.

- Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.

- Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.

Professional Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.

- 2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.

- Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.

- Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.

- Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.

- Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.

- Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.

- Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.

- Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.

- Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.

- Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Sound like you? Apply now!

jobs.title: Compliance Officer US
jobs.description:
ABOUT THUNES

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world.

Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets, stablecoin wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 220 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay HK and many more.  Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments, globally.  Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks. Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Atlanta, Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, Hong Kong, Johannesburg, London, Manila, Nairobi, New York, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com .

THUNES IN THE US

Thunes Financial Services LLC is a Delaware limited liability company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It is registered as a money services business with FinCEN and licensed as a money transmitter (or statutory equivalent) in all U.S. States and Territories where required.

The company provides a cross-border payment network that includes remittance processing, corporate mass payouts, business to business payments, and digital payment services.  Its customers include money transfer operators (“MTOs”), payment services providers, creator economy platforms, marketplaces, digital merchants, fintechs, corporates, banks, and mobile wallets.

CONTEXT OF THE ROLE

Based in San Francisco, reporting to the Americas Compliance Director based in Miami, this role in the US Compliance team will support the compliance function in the United States of America, and will support Thunes’ activities there and globally.

This role is expected to partner with the Global Compliance function (including the Financial Crime team, the KYC team, and the Risk team, among others) and other cross-functional teams (Legal, Account Management & Business Development, Finance & Treasury, Product etc) based across the world.

The role is an office-based role, subject to Thunes’ Office Working Policy, based out of the Company’s offices in San Francisco.

The position provides an exciting opportunity to work on an international stage, alongside household names, and join a rapidly growing FinTech company making a real impact on the lives of people in developed and emerging markets alike.

The ideal candidate will be someone who has previously held senior payments’ compliance roles in organisations such as:

- Payment Services Providers (incl. MTOs, acquiring PSPs)

- Banks or Financial Institutions

- Traditional banks active in the digital payments space

- Neo-banks (e.g. Monzo, Revolut and the likes)

- BaaS actors (Banking as a Service like Cybrid, Plaid)

- Crypto assets actor (e.g. exchange, liquidity provider, blockchain infrastructure)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Supporting the business

- Reviewing the adequacy of Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Know Your Customer (KYC), Know Your Business (KYB), source of funds, client information, client profiling and suitability during the account opening process - ensuring that financial crime risks are assessed and mitigated, meeting all best practice, regulatory and statutory requirements,

- Provide guidance and support to senior management and the board regarding the firm's risk-based approach to AML/CTF,

- Support and manage client reviews (sometimes onsite) conducted by Thunes as part of enhanced due diligence activities.

- Handle RFP processes and make sure about the quality of answers

Compliance risks management

- Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential money laundering and terrorist financing risks and assess the effectiveness of the controls that the firm has put against these risks,

- Assist in the management of remediation items (e.g. development of change management controls when needed)

- Develop and strengthen relationships to promote best practice and ensure a good understanding of Financial Crime requirements,

- Contribute to the design of policies and the Compliance Programme,

- Execute the Compliance Monitoring Programme by producing quality reviews

Liaison with regulators

- Support with the preparation of local exams and periodical/ad hoc reportings to the regulators

- Liaise with local law enforcement and regulators to resolve issues - investigating any suspicion raised for a suspicious transaction, in consultation with the MLRO and preparing SAR reports to US FIU (FinCEN),

- Help maintain money transmission licenses, including and renewing licenses, handling, gathering, and updating sensitive corporate information, and submitting monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting to regulators

- Management of open license items in the NMLS

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience & Knowledge

- 3 to 5 years of professional experience as Compliance in the payment industry

- Master 2 University Degree or equ. in Law, Criminal Law, Business Law

- Expertise in compliance areas within a financially regulated company including namely AML/TF, Risk & Permanent Control, Business minded and able to support the development of innovative payment services

- Experience in virtual currencies/blockchain is a strong plus

Skills & Competencies

- Experience working in an international and diverse environment

- Excellent written and verbal communicator in English with fluency in Spanish being a plus

- High level of autonomy and proactivity

- Ability to work well under pressure, different priorities, and tight deadlines,

- Collaborative work approach

jobs.description:

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 12 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco, Sao Paulo and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented Temporary Digital Marketing Manager to join our team in Paris for an 8-month contract running from October 2026 through May 2027.

With a newly launched website and a busy calendar of external events throughout this period, you will support our digital growth initiatives by coordinating with our external LinkedIn ads and web/SEO agencies, executing email campaigns, exploring modern search visibility (AEO/GEO), and tracking marketing-sourced pipeline performance using our modern tech stack.

This role offers a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious digital marketer to take operational ownership across agency management, marketing automation, multi-touch attribution, and modern search optimization.

Key Responsibilities

- Agency Coordination: Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for external agencies managing our LinkedIn Ads , SEO , and website management to ensure campaign execution aligns with event timelines and post-launch web optimizations.

- Email Marketing & Nurture: Execute and manage email campaigns and lead nurture journeys using Pardot (Salesforce Account Engagement).

- AEO & GEO Strategy: Drive Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) tactics to secure digital visibility across modern AI search engines.

- Attribution & Performance Reporting: Track marketing-sourced opportunity attributions and revenue impact using Dreamdata , building routine dashboards to analyze channel performance.

- Event Digital Support: Deliver digital promotion and campaign execution surrounding our intensive external event schedule from October 2026 through May 2027.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal marketing stakeholders and external agency teams to keep all digital projects on schedule.

Requirements

- Language: Fluent in English (written and verbal) is strictly required. (French language skills are not required).

- Experience: 1–3 years of experience in B2B digital marketing roles.

- Tech Stack & Tools:

- Marketing Automation: Hands-on experience or working knowledge of Pardot (Salesforce Account Engagement).

- Attribution: Familiarity or hands-on experience with Dreamdata (or similar multi-touch revenue attribution platforms).

- Paid Media & Search: Practical understanding of LinkedIn Ads management (working alongside external agencies) and core SEO principles.

- Content Management: Practical experience with WordPress CMS for content updates, page optimization, and basic site maintenance post-launch.

- ABM Platforms: Working knowledge of 6sense (or similar ABM intent platforms) to track account-level intent, align with target lists, and support targeted campaigns.

- Emerging Tech: Curiosity and practical understanding of AEO/GEO concepts and using AI tools to optimize daily workflows.

- Analytical Skills: Solid understanding of marketing attribution, CRM data structures, and performance metrics analysis.

- Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage external agency deliverables and multiple event timelines concurrently.

THUNES IN THE UK

We act as a trusted, neutral aggregator in a deeply fragmented industry. We offer on one hand end-to-end payments solutions to tackle the speed, cost-efficiency, and accessibility challenges for emerging markets ; and on the other payment capacities related to virtual world games.

Thanks to Thunes’ Authorized Payment Institution license in the UK, as well as other registrations across the world, Thunes UK is able to provide a variety of Accept (payment acquisition) and Pay (payout) services to clients and partners based in the UK and abroad.

CONTEXT OF THE ROLE

Based in London, reporting to the UK Compliance Manager & MLRO based in London, this role will support the compliance function in the United Kingdom, and will support Thunes activities all across the world where the license and registrations are used.

This role is expected to partner with the Global Compliance function (including the Financial Crime team, the KYC team, and the Risk team, among others) and other cross-functional teams (Legal, Account Management & Business Development, Finance & Treasury, Product etc) based across the world.

The role is an office-based role, based out of the Company’s offices in London.

The position provides an exciting opportunity to work on an international stage, alongside household names, and join a rapidly growing FinTech company making a real impact on the lives of people in developed and emerging markets alike.

The ideal candidate should be someone who has previously held senior payments’ compliance roles in organisations like:

- Payment Services Providers (incl. MTOs, acquiring PSPs)

- Banks or Financial Institutions

- Traditional banks active in the digital payments space

- Neo-banks (e.g. Monzo, Revolut and the likes)

- BaaS actors (Banking as a Service like Cybrid, Plaid)

- Crypto assets actor (e.g. exchange, liquidity provider, blockchain infrastructure)

- Provide guidance and support to senior management and the board regarding the firm's risk-based approach to AML/CTF,

- Support and manage client reviews (sometimes onsite) conducted by Thunes as part of enhanced due diligence activities.

Compliance risks management

- Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential money laundering and terrorist financing risks and assess the effectiveness of the controls that the firm has put against these risks,

- Working with the business to ensure that the firm establishes and maintains appropriate policies, procedures, systems and controls, monitoring reviews and support for external regulatory obligations,

- Develop and strengthen relationships to promote best practice and ensure a good understanding of Financial Crime requirements,

- Contribute to the design of the Policies and the Compliance Programme,
